name: Francisco Federico Reyes-Bravo
crime: Charged: FORT WORTH, Texas — United States Attorney for the Northern District of Texas Ryan Raybould announced that an illegal alien from Mexico has been indicted for falsely claiming to be a U.S. Citizen after allegedly attempting to enter the country using a fraudulently obtained U.S. passport at Dallas Fort Worth International Airport.
